subject: Founders track eligibility + econ anchor — follow-up and next steps
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@orchid.ai>
Cc: Elena Park <elena@orchid.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Founders track eligibility + econ anchor — follow-up and next steps

Hi Samir / Elena — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from my side: 

Call highlights:
- Current usage: OrchidAI is running ~120 million tokens/month in prod experiments, spikes to ~220M on test days (primarily long-context summarization & reranking flows).
- Target economics: you called out goal of ~$650-$750 per 1M tokens for inference to hit your unit targets for Q4.
- Budget window: you said FY27 engineering + infra budget currently scoped at $210k–$320k/quarter for inference (approx).
- Accelerator note: mentioned you have YC follow-on capital and an acceleration stipend that could qualify you for a founders program.

Our asks / proposed immediate asks:
1) Confirm expected steady-state monthly tokens for the next 6 months (best-effort number).
2) Confirm whether your finance team can commit to a 6–12 month reserved capacity / committed spend (any cadence — monthly billing + commit).
3) If you want founders track starter credit + founder-rate (one-time runway credit), we need the signed eligibility form (attached) and a short org-level proof (accelerator intro or addition to Cap table).

Attached I dropped a short mutual-action plan (orchid-ma-plan-draft.pdf) and two quick pricing scenarios (pricing-scenarios.xlsx):
- Option A (starter): 3 month runway credit + 20% off list for first 1M tokens used (no commit).
- Option B (founders + 6mo commit): $500/1M token target at a 6‑month commit (min monthly commit 50M tokens) plus $15k founder credit applied up front.

If you want a second-pass number that gets to your $650–$750 target without an initial commit, we can look at multi-model routing + KV cache tuning to reduce effective unit price — I can loop in Neha for a quick technical audit.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm the steady-state # and whether finance wants a 6mo committed option by EOD Tues (2027-06-08).
- I’ll pull Ben & our pricing team if you confirm interest in a multi-year / rebate path.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0197

- When I said 120M tokens/month, that’s current prod baseline for text gen only. With rerank/similarity it’s ~180M. We expect steady growth to ~300M/mo if one additional integration ships in Q4.
- Budget: finance wants options they can model: (i) pure pay-as-you-go at a target unit price, (ii) 6mo commitment, (iii) 12mo. They prefer seeing mid-case and worst-case burn.
- Founder credit: happy to provide the accelerator intro; Elena will share a PDF of the accelerator approval later today.

Ask from us: can you sketch a 6-month commit that gets us into the ~$650–$750/1M tokens range? If that requires an initial lump or minimum monthly commit, tell us what the floor is.

Ben / Neha — forwarding the thread. Customer is OrchidAI (seed, accelerator-backed). They run ~180M tokens/mo today across gen+rerank, expect growth. They asked explicitly for a 6mo commit that lives near $650–$750/1M tokens.

Proposed approach:
- Starter (no commit): founder credit + 20% off first 1M tokens as trial (ok).
- 6mo commit variant A: min monthly commit 50M tokens -> tiered pricing that yields ~$700/1M at 200M/mo (no upfront).
- 6mo commit variant B: min monthly commit 100M tokens + $25k upfront prepayment -> target $500/1M at 250M/mo (subject to legal sign-off).

Do you see any legal/finance blockers with the upfront prepay in variant B? If we can get a soft approval I’ll send a short proposal + DocuSign link to the customer.

—Rishi

- Variant A (50M min): fine from pricing perspective; likely an approval at manager level. Leaves flexibility for customer and protects us on volatility.
- Variant B (100M + $25k upfront): finance will want explicit language around credits applied and an escrow for refunds if usage drops below committed baseline; legal will need a short SOW addendum. I think we can get LOE but will need CS visibility for onboarding support intensity (Neha to confirm).
